Thanks,

Subject: Re: Renewal intent + 30% capacity bump (18-month term)

Marissa / team —

I reviewed Aperture_OrderForm_v3.docx and added line-level comments in the attached redline (RD-APD-2026-0012_orderform_redline_Markus.docx). High-level we can accommodate the 18-month term and capacity increase, but please note the following points Aperture should expect to negotiate:

1) Termination & proration — the proposed language ties proration to a 30-day notice; we typically require a 60-day termination-for-convenience notice on terms longer than 12 months to protect capacity planning. Recommend counter: 60 days.

2) SLA credits — the order form requests unlimited stacking with other credits. We’ll cap credits for platform-level incidents at a percentage of monthly fees per incident (per MSA). Need confirmation from product whether sustained outage definitions align with the MSA Sec 5.

3) Indemnity and liability — there’s an expanded carve-in for third-party claims in Section 9. We should preserve Redwood’s existing liability cap (12 months of fees or $1M, whichever is lower) and strike language expanding indemnity scope.

4) Data residency / export controls — we can confirm us-west hosting; however, customer-requested cross-border processing (if any analytics partners are outside the region) needs an explicit exception in Exhibit C.

5) Billing & audit rights — procurement asked for audit access to logs; we prefer a quarterly review window rather than on-demand audits. Offer: one annual technical audit plus pre-notified quarterly evidence exchange.

I flagged these in the redline. Marissa — recommend we send a tracked redline and a short cover email outlining the five negotiation points and proposed compromises. Sofia / Aperture — if you want to accelerate, happy to join a 30-min legal sync next week.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference
(attachment: RD-APD-2026-0012_orderform_redline_Markus.docx)
